responsibility: Implements the IPA static-variable reference analysis that tracks which module-local statics each function may read or write, both locally and transitively through calls. It assigns stable bitmap IDs to interesting statics, gathers local accesses, propagates read/write sets through the callgraph, maintains optimization summaries and varpool removal hooks, and streams these summaries for LTO. Its purpose is call-clobber and local-static usage information, distinct from the generic ipa_ref edge infrastructure.
same_name_distinction: Implements the separate IPA pass over module-local statics, building and propagating read/write bitmaps across the call graph and streaming optimization summaries; unlike ipa-ref.cc, it is analysis over references, not the generic ipa_ref edge container implementation.
